subject: [hw] DONE P04 rev 1: 5031 checks (adds a link+run against P03's real client); no behaviour change
body:
DONE P04 rev 1. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit outside gpu/hwcodec/vt/**.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/vt/test/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST P04 PASS 5031/5031
     annexb.c ASan+UBSan 725, -O2 725; encoder object ASan+UBSan 1193, -O2 1193, TSan 1193;
     P03 real-client link+run 2 (T_LINK registered=3 available=0);
     P04 ios compile: 4/4 objects for arm64-apple-ios16.0 (build_ios.sh flags, -Werror).

Since rev 0 (no object behaviour change):
- New vt/test/t_link.c and a run_tests.sh step that compiles P03's client/n2vcd_client.c, n2vcd_transport.c and n2vc_hw_dev.c, links them with my four objects (default seam, no fake client), and runs the binary: registration 3/3 through the fake VT, n2hwenc_vt_available() 0 on the host (no relay). This proves the nine weak names in vt/n2hwenc_client.c resolve against P03's committed header/library and that the fallback probe works with the real client. The step skips cleanly if client/** is absent.
- vt/STATUS.md and dsh-state/workers/P04/STATUS.md updated with the new count and the P03 link evidence.

R2's two findings are on the board with my answers: F32 (-12915 retry set [I]) stays open as stated - the cache's export trie is in the decmpfs-compressed dyldlinkedit subcache and I did not decode it - with the switch-file recommendation as the safe mitigation; F33 (build lines + registration hook) is waiting on hw-ip and is described precisely as 'compiled and link-checked, not yet in the product link'. Everything else from the DONE post stands: no phone run, 'hvc1' uses the real CoreMedia HEVC parameter-set call declared in vt/n2hwenc_vt.h, NV12 only, synchronous, one hardware session per object. Staying available for review.
